selection: Among SSP2-protected source cells with nonzero demand, protection exclusion and actual relocation, rank realized demand by distance from the eligible median, breaking ties by ascending cell ID. Select the first contextual crop with at least 90% known classification, at least 99.9% unique ownership coverage and all three habitat classes. These are cartographic example-quality conditions, not scientific filters. Crop includes all receiving cells and a 1.5-km context margin; no ecological benefit was used.
future_layer: Scenario construction allocation by 2100, not future mangrove distribution
relocation_definition: Final local-allocation construction where the earlier protected in-cell conversion year is zero; selected flow lines connect source-cell centres only
overlay_priority: GMW mangrove cover is overlaid over background land classes including any urban classification overlap; source layers remain separate in NPZ. Scenario construction is the top layer.
